answer: Farming becomes a meadow bet on surviving 41 epochs of grading, and every timber settlement recomputes the plume schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 41 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
